title: Download a build
summary: Priya's focused download of DJDL 4.2.0: breadcrumb, identity row, the chosen build (platform, architecture, file type, size), its channel and date, the SHA-256 with Copy, the install hint, one Download, and other platforms folded. On a phone it says it is showing desktop builds and offers Email me the download instead.
compare: The chosen build matches the visitor's device (macOS, Universal) and says platform, architecture, file type and size in one line (PX-29, portal-27).
SHA-256 is on this page as well as the product page (P2-13), mono, middle-truncated at rest, with a Copy button named for the value.
One primary: Download for macOS on a computer; on a phone 'You're viewing desktop builds' and Email me the download instead (no phone build is offered).
Other platforms fold into one row; download controls never move during transitions (MO-13).
Breadcrumb 'Library › DJDL' and the identity row (no cropped art band); short-desktop two columns as portal.free-device.
